name: Mikkabi (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Mikkabi town emblem in orange: a ring open at the upper fly with three curved strokes.
history: Flag of the former town of Mikkabi in Shizuoka Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-07-01. The municipal emblem was adopted in 1959.

features.role: Mikkabi town emblem — a ring open at the upper fly with three curved strokes
